name: Gem Digger
description: A marble-shooter mode on an auto-scrolling board. Shoot colored marbles to pop matching groups down to the conveyor, and free the gems buried in the field.
howToPlay: Aim with your finger and tap to shoot. Forming a group of 3+ same-color marbles releases them — and anything left hanging below drops too. Wrong-color shots stick and fill the board. Free a gem by clearing whatever holds it up from below. Collect 3 gems to win — but don't let the board reach the red danger line or the conveyor overflow!
